comments.author: @TravelKismet
comments.text: From grinding wild cacao with stones and making chocobanano to shamanic healing and the Boruca resistance dances in Costa Rica's rainforests, it's fascinating to see how these communities hold onto ancestral rhythms without electricity or modern infrastructure. You can really feel how closely their daily routines stay tied to the forest and river
